selection: fixed named channels recorded in code; not performance selected; multi-sensor Brienz grouped; original archives retained
external_failure_phase: published terminal/main catastrophic collapse, not first onset of any slow mechanical motion
timestamp_policy: naive source clocks retained; only explicit UTC columns receive UTC, label-clock equivalence remains curator assumption; no fabricated UTC epoch

post_failure_rule: strict before label lower; raw later measurements retained only in archive
